items.description:
🔴 همکاری برای مدیریت سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی

🔹 شرح کلی پروژه:
همکاری برای انجام امور عملیاتی و پشتیبانی یک سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی موجود. حوزه همکاری شامل ثبت محصول، پشتیبانی سایت، انجام تمامی امور سئو و طراحی گرافیک موردنیاز سایت، به‌ویژه بنر و اسلایدر است.
محدوده کار و مسئولیت فریلنسر:
• ثبت و به‌روزرسانی محصولات در سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی
• پشتیبانی و رسیدگی به امور موردنیاز سایت
• بررسی وضعیت سئو و اجرای اقدامات اصلاحی و بهبودهای لازم؛ تمامی امور سئو در دامنه همکاری قرار دارد.
• طراحی اقلام گرافیکی موردنیاز سایت، شامل بنر و اسلایدر
وضعیت فعلی و بستر پروژه:
سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی موجود است و همکاری بر پایه رسیدگی و بهبود همین سایت انجام می‌شود، نه ایجاد یک سایت جدید. جزئیات حجم ثبت محصولات، نوع درخواست‌های پشتیبانی و محدوده هر فعالیت سئو می‌تواند با توجه به نیازهای جاری سایت در زمان همکاری مشخص شود.
نحوه همکاری:
همکاری می‌تواند به‌صورت ساعتی، دائمی یا پروژه‌ای انجام شود. جزئیات شیوه همکاری، حجم کار و برآورد هزینه لازم است در پیشنهاد فریلنسر مشخص شود.
موارد پیشنهادی برای بررسی در پروپوزال:
• تجربه مرتبط با مدیریت سایت‌های فروشگاهی وردپرسی، ثبت محصول، پشتیبانی، سئو و طراحی بنر و اسلایدر

• برآورد هزینه بر اساس نوع همکاری ساعتی، پروژه‌ای یا مستمر
• نمونه‌کارهای مرتبط و فرضیات یا اطلاعات موردنیاز برای شروع همکاری

items.title: سئوی وبسایت فروشگاه کتاب
items.description:
🔴 سئوی وبسایت فروشگاه کتاب

🔹 سلام و درود
وبسایت فروشگاه آنلاین کتاب در زمینه های قانون جذب، موفقیت، ثروت و ... هستش و از فروردین 1404 بالا اومده و به صورت اختصاصی با لاراول برنامه نویسی شده است.
خودم طراح و برنامه نویس وبسایت هستم، میتونم بگم سئوی تکنیکال، سرعت و چینش تگهارو به خوبی برای وبسایت اعمال کردم و موردی بنظر ندارند و تابحال هیچ سئوی خارجی به جز فعالیت در شبکه های اجتماعی، برای این سایت انجام نشده و هیچ بک لینک و رپورتاژ آگهی انجام ندادیم.
درخواستی که از شما دارم اینه که سئوی خارجی رو خودتون در دست بگیرید و کارهای سئوی داخلی رو شما مشاوره میدین که من خودم انجامشون بدم.
درحال حاضر در کلمه کلیدی "کتاب های نویل گادارد" رتبه 1 رو داریم.
اما نمیدونم چرا "کتاب های کوین ترودو" سرچ شدنی مقاله "17 کتاب پیشنهادی کوین ترودو" در رتبه دوم گوگل قرار میگیره.
کلمات کلیدی که همچنین روشون کار میکنیم "کتاب های قانون جذب" "کتاب های مدیریت مالی" "کتاب های توسعه فردی"
اینکه همچنین مهم هستش که تمام تک به تک کتاب ها هم همراه با همین دسته بندی ها بالا بیان.
ابتدا باهم 3 ماه کار میکنیم، درصورت رضایت دوطرفه در یک پروژه جدید باهم ادامه خواهیم داد.
کمک به شما!!!!!!!!!!!

items.title: طراحی و توسعه پلتفرم آنلاین تخصصی حیوانات خانگی
items.description:
🔴 ساخت اپلیکشین اندروید

🔹 عنوان پروژه: طراحی و توسعه پلتفرم آنلاین تخصصی حیوانات خانگی
به دنبال یک برنامه‌نویس یا تیم حرفه‌ای برای طراحی و توسعه یک وب‌اپلیکیشن موبایلی در حوزه حیوانات خانگی هستم.
پلتفرم موردنظر ترکیبی از جست‌وجو و مقایسه قیمت محصولات، معرفی فروشگاه‌ها و ارائه‌دهندگان خدمات، نوبت‌دهی آنلاین و امکانات مدیریت مراقبت از حیوانات خواهد بود.
مهارت‌های موردنیاز:
* تجربه ساخت مارکت‌پلیس و پلتفرم‌های مقایسه قیمت
* تسلط به طراحی و توسعه وب‌اپلیکیشن واکنش‌گرا
* تجربه طراحی دیتابیس، پنل مدیریت و سیستم جست‌وجو

items.title: Senior SEO Specialist (B2B Tech Agency)
items.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior SEO & AEO Specialist (B2B Tech / Agency)

Location:  Bangalore

Type:  Full-time

Experience:  3-8 years in SEO/AEO (B2B Tech / SaaS experience required; Agency experience preferred)

About The Role

We are looking for an analytical, modern, and outcome-oriented Senior SEO & AEO Specialist to manage organic growth strategies across a portfolio of B2B technology clients.

In this agency role, you won't just run traditional SEO campaigns-you will bridge technical SEO, high-intent keyword strategies, and cutting-edge Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

You must be a natural problem-solver who uses AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive execution, free up strategic bandwidth, and deliver clear pipeline results for multi-client accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Keyword & Entity Strategy (SEO + AEO)

High-Intent B2B Keyword Mapping: Uncover non-branded, high-intent BOFU (Bottom-of-Funnel) keywords, intent clusters, and buyer queries that drive pipeline rather than just vanity traffic.

AEO & LLM Optimization: Identify entity relationships, brand citations, and prompt queries used across AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot).

Search Intent & Gap Analysis: Run competitive content gap analyses to map buyer journeys across traditional search SERPs and AI response outputs.

On-Page & Content Optimization

AEO Content Engineering: Structure and optimize client content for direct retrieval by LLMs-focusing on concise answer blocks, clear headers, schema alignment, and authoritative citations.

On-Page Execution: Optimize meta tags, heading hierarchies, internal linking structures, CTA placements, and content freshups across client web properties.

AI-Assisted Content Briefs: Produce detailed, data-backed content briefs using AI workflows to scale quality output for client writing teams.

Technical SEO & Site Architecture

Comprehensive Audits: Perform deep-dive technical audits across complex B2B sites.

Technical Fixes: Resolve issues related to crawlability, indexability, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, page speed, canonicalization, and XML sitemaps.

Schema & Structured Data: Implement advanced schema markup (Organization, Product, Article, FAQ, TechArticle) to strengthen site entities for both search engines and LLM indexers.

Off-Page & Brand Authority

Digital PR & Citation Strategy: Build brand authority and digital footprint through high-quality B2B backlink profiles, unlinked mention reclamation, and strategic guest placements.

LLM Visibility Building: Drive inclusion in trusted third-party review sites (G2, Capterra, Gartner), tech publications, and industry directories that modern LLMs use as grounding data.

AI-Powered Automation & Workflow Scaling

Task Automation: Leverage custom GPTs, APIs, or automation platforms (Make, Zapier, Python scripts) to automate repetitive tasks like meta creation, internal link mapping, technical monitoring, and keyword clustering.

Workflow Optimization: Use AI tools to accelerate strategy creation and analysis without sacrificing quality or accuracy.

Analytics, Client Reporting & Growth Ownership

Multi-Client Portfolio Management: Simultaneously balance campaign strategy, technical execution, and project timelines across 4–6 B2B tech accounts.

Data & Attribution Modeling: Analyze performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and BI tools (Looker Studio) to track traffic, conversions, MQLs, and SQLs.

Client Presentations & Communication: Translate complex technical data into clear business narratives. Lead monthly/quarterly strategy calls with CMOs, VP of Marketing, and demand gen leaders.

Problem Solving & Result Delivery: Proactively identify drop-offs or algorithm impact, pivot strategies rapidly, and take personal accountability for achieving quarterly KPIs (pipeline growth, keyword ownership, AI share of voice).

Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 8 years of hands-on SEO/AEO experience, with a heavy emphasis on B2B Tech or SaaS brands.

Agency Experience: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize tasks under deadlines, and pivot strategies based on client goals.
AEO & Generative Search Expertise: Solid understand of vector search, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), entity graphs, and how modern AI tools retrieve and synthesise content.
AI & Automation Proficiency: Practical, hands-on experience using AI software and automation scripts to handle heavy-lifting operational tasks.
Client-Facing Skills: Strong verbal and written communication. Comfortable presenting data, answering tough questions on calls, and advising client marketing leads.
Tool Stack Mastery: Advanced experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, and Looker Studio.

Company paid health insurance for you and your family
Exposure to global B2B technology clients
Opportunity to work with modern marketing and AI tools
Collaborative team culture

من دو هدف اصلی دارم:
1. با توجه به وضعیت فعلی هر سایت، رقبا و شرایط بازار، مشخص کنیم کدام برندها چقدر پتانسیل رشد دارند و با اجرای یک استراتژی سئوی مناسب، تا چه حد می‌توان رتبه و ترافیک آن‌ها را افزایش داد؟
از آنجا که با مدیران این برندها در ارتباط هستم، می‌خواهم روی سایت‌هایی تمرکز کنم که واقعاً ظرفیت پیشرفت قابل‌توجهی دارند. هدفم این است که با بهبود سئوی آن‌ها، تأثیر کار ما بر افزایش بازدید و در نهایت فروش، به‌وضوح قابل‌اندازه‌گیری باشد.
2. یک گزارش خیلی کامل از وضعیت این برندها از در سیستم‌های هوش مصنوعی می‌خوام، مثلا نظر چت جی پی تی، کلاد، Google Overviews و... لطفا از تجربیات AEO بگید.
دسترسی به آنالیتیکس یا سرچ کنسول نداریم و کل بررسی باید از بیرون انجام بشه.
این نکته رو اضافه کنم که خودم متخصص سئو هستم، پس لطفا از تحلیل‌های سطحی و وعده‌های رویایی دوری کنید، هرچه پیشنهادتون به واقعیت نزدیکتر باشه من شما رو کاندید جدی‌تری می‌بینم.

items.title: SEO/GEO specialist (junior)

Haal jij energie uit het verbeteren van de online vindbaarheid van bedrijven? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om bovenaan in Google te komen én te zorgen voor een betere vindbaarheid in ChatGPT? Word dan onderdeel van ons team!

Als SEO/GEO specialist zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten vindbaar zijn in (AI-gestuurde) zoekmachines. Samen veroveren we hoge posities om meer verkeer naar de website te realiseren. Door in deze missie te slagen, kunnen we onze klanten helpen om (online) te groeien.

Je gaat aan de slag voor meerdere klanten, die je op termijn zelf kunt bedienen. We spreken onze klanten voornamelijk digitaal, maar soms bezoek je ook klanten om samen dingen door te nemen.

Wij zijn Stek Online
Al sinds 2012 hét online marketing bureau uit het Westland. Ons doel is om bedrijven (online) te helpen groeien met behulp van online marketing. Met onze Westlandse mentaliteit steken wij de handen uit de mouwen om resultaten voor onze klanten te boeken. Wij specialiseren ons in zoekmachine en social media marketing, maar kijken steeds een stap verder. We adverteren tegenwoordig bijvoorbeeld ook in ChatGPT.

Ons klantenbestand bestaat uit multinationals, maar ook lokale ondernemers. De verbindende factor is dat zij samen met ons willen groeien. Met trots werken we voor bedrijven als Jens Onderlinge Hypotheken, Oude & Nieuwe Kerk Delft, Strandpark Vlugtenburg en nog veel meer.

Dit ben jij, heb jij en kun jij..
Je hebt minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau. Bij voorkeur in de richting van marketing, communicatie of online media. Een diploma in een andere richting is voor ons geen reden om je niet uit te nodigen.
Je hebt kennis en ervaring (pré) op het gebied van SEO en GEO.
Je hebt kennis van of interesse in de werking van LLM’s (bijv. ChatGPT).

Je stelt strategieën op om de vindbaarheid in (AI-gestuurde) zoekmachines te verbeteren.

Gezellige collega’s (al zeggen we het zelf) die houden van een borrel, potje darten en vooral gezelligheid.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
items.description:
Blinto is looking for a data-driven and execution-focused SEO Strategist who can take ownership of organic growth from strategy to implementation and reporting.

This role is for someone who can look beyond rankings and understand how technical SEO, content, search intent, authority, user experience, and conversion work together to create sustainable organic growth.

You will work across Blinto and client websites, identifying SEO opportunities, building clear roadmaps, working with content and development teams, and measuring whether the work is actually producing results.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable digging into data, identifying the real reason behind performance changes, prioritizing what matters most, and turning SEO insights into practical actions.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct comprehensive SEO audits across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content, internal linking, indexing, and backlink health, then turn findings into prioritized action plans.
Perform keyword, competitor, and search-intent research to identify opportunities that can generate relevant organic traffic, leads, and business growth.
Lead on-page and content optimization, including metadata, heading structure, internal linking, content quality, topical relevance, and E-E-A-T considerations.
Work closely with developers on technical SEO improvements such as Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, schema, redirects, site architecture, and website performance.
Monitor rankings, traffic, conversions, backlinks, and search visibility, then prepare clear monthly reports with insights, priorities, and recommended next actions.

Who We Are Looking For:

You may be a strong fit if you:
Have 2–3 years of hands-on SEO experience in an agency, in-house team, or similar professional environment.
Can independently investigate SEO problems instead of relying only on automated audit scores or tool recommendations.
Understand the connection between search intent, content quality, technical SEO, authority, and conversion.
Are comfortable working with developers, writers, designers, and growth teams to move SEO initiatives forward.
Take ownership of results, communicate clearly, and are willing to test, learn, and continuously improve your approach.

Experience & Knowledge:

Strong practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, content optimization, internal linking, and backlink analysis .
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio .
Good understanding of Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, redirects, schema markup, canonicalization, and website architecture .
Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS , with the ability to communicate technical SEO requirements clearly to developers.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to connect SEO performance to traffic, leads, conversions, and business objectives.
Experience with Local SEO, Google Business Profile, GTM, digital PR, SQL, Python for SEO, or SEO automation will be considered an advantage.

What We Value:

At Blinto, we look for SEO professionals who:
Focus on measurable growth rather than rankings alone.
Use data to understand problems before recommending solutions.
Prioritize work based on potential impact instead of trying to fix everything at once.
Can explain SEO clearly to both technical and non-technical team members.
Take ownership of recommendations and follow them through to implementation.
Keep learning as search, AI, algorithms, and user behavior continue to evolve.
Want to grow with Blinto and contribute to building a stronger organic growth capability over the long term.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary based on experience and capability.
Yearly salary review and increment based on performance.
Festival bonuses.
Subsidized breakfast and lunch.
Transportation allowance.
Paid time off.
Yearly best performer recognition and bonus.
A supportive environment focused on learning, ownership, and professional growth.
Opportunity to work across different industries, websites, and real business growth challenges.

Ready To Apply?

If you enjoy turning SEO data into clear strategies, solving technical and content problems, and building organic growth that contributes to real business outcomes, we would like to hear from you.
Please apply with your CV and, where possible, examples or case studies of SEO projects you have worked on.
Blinto evaluates candidates based on SEO knowledge, analytical ability, problem-solving, execution skills, ownership, communication, and suitability for the role .

items.description:
We’re Hiring: SEO Specialist | 2–3 Years’ Experience | Work From Office

We are looking for a hands-on SEO Specialist with 2–3 years of experience (minimum 2 years) who doesn’t just plan SEO, but implements it directly on websites.

The right person stays up to date with how search is changing, including AI search, AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) , and doesn’t rely on outdated tactics.

They should use AI strategically to work faster and smarter, while still applying their own judgement.
Work Type: Work from office, with occasional work from home as and when needed.

Key Responsibilities:
⁠ ⁠Plan and implement on-page, technical and content SEO across WordPress, Shopify and custom-coded websites
⁠ ⁠Fix technical SEO issues directly, including site speed, Core Web Vitals, indexing, crawl errors, redirects, canonicals and sitemaps
⁠ ⁠Implement schema markup and structured data to improve visibility in search and AI results
⁠ ⁠Optimise content to appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other AI-driven search platforms
⁠ ⁠Research, plan and produce articles that rank on both traditional search and AI answer engines
⁠ ⁠Use AI tools strategically for research, content creation, audits and workflows, without sacrificing quality or accuracy
⁠ ⁠Manage Google Search Console, GA4 and other SEO tools to track and report on performance
⁠ ⁠Run SEO audits and turn findings into clear, prioritised actions, then carry them out
⁠ ⁠Build topical authority, internal linking structures and quality backlinks
⁠ ⁠Identify and clean up spam, toxic links and indexing issues
⁠ ⁠Track algorithm updates and adapt strategy quickly
⁠ ⁠Work closely with development, design, content and marketing teams

What We’re Looking For:
⁠ ⁠ Minimum 2 years (ideally 2–3 years) of hands-on SEO experience with proven ranking results
⁠ ⁠Strong understanding of technical SEO and confidence making changes on live websites
⁠ ⁠Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and CMS platforms like WordPress and Shopify
⁠ ⁠Up-to-date knowledge of AEO, GEO and AI search behaviour
⁠ ⁠Experience using AI tools smartly, with critical thinking rather than blind reliance
⁠ ⁠Ability to write or brief content that ranks and genuinely answers user questions
⁠ ⁠Data-driven mindset with the ability to read analytics and act on them
⁠ ⁠Ability to work independently and take ownership without hand-holding
⁠ ⁠ Good communication and professional behaviour when working across teams
⁠ ⁠A proactive, curious and results-focused approach to work

We are looking for someone who can identify what’s holding a website back, understand why, and fix it themselves.

Apply via LinkedIn or send us your CV along with examples of websites or articles you have ranked.

items.title: SEO Specialist
items.description:
En SIDN te queremos

¿Eres una persona apasionada del SEO que ha enfocado su desarrollo en el nuevo paradigma GEO y Search IA?

Buscamos a una persona apasionada del SEO y el aprendizaje contínuo,con visión analítica, autonomía y enfoque estratégico para gestionar proyectos de medio y alto nivel.

Tu objetivo será conectar los datos y necesidades del negocio con la visibilidad y presencia en motores de búsqueda generativos y LLM.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Ejecutar estrategias GEO avanzadas y gestionar de forma autónoma proyectos clave en SIDN.
Actuar como referente operativo dentro de un equipo internacional de alto rendimiento.
Colaborar de manera transversal con otras áreas y especialistas para potenciar búsquedas multimodales (Dev, Paid, UX, CRO, ORM, etc.).
Generar un impacto directo y medible en el crecimiento orgánico, tráfico cualificado, menciones y citas en LLMs y negocio de los clientes.

¿Qué esperamos de ti ?

Desarrollar un research avanzado que integre queries tradicionales, intención semántica y patrones de búsqueda en LLMs.
Trabajar las entidades y la autoridad de forma integral (consistencia de marca, contenidos, arquitectura web, PR digital).
Definir y ejecutar estrategias de contenido multimodal y EEAT accionable (texto, imágenes, vídeo, señales on-site y off-site).
Diseñar estrategias SEO locales e internacionales adaptadas a distintos mercados y contextos culturales.
Gestionar proyectos priorizando iniciativas según su impacto, esfuerzo y retorno mediante roadmaps claros.
Impulsar la sinergia entre los distintos equipos (Producto, Dev, Contenidos, Paid, etc.) para maximizar el impacto global.
Convertir los datos en decisiones de negocio mediante analítica web, herramientas GEO y dashboards, comunicando los resultados y oportunidades al cliente.

Competencias

SEO Técnico Avanzado: Conocimiento profundo de arquitectura web, datos estructurados y marcado semántico.
Estrategia de Contenidos: Experiencia en la creación de clústeres temáticos y contenidos de alta autoridad.
Stack Tecnológico: Valorable el manejo de herramientas SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush) combinadas con plataformas de IA y automatización (Python, SQL o herramientas RAG).
Pensamiento analítico y estratégico con una clara orientación a resultados de negocio.
Comunicación clara y eficaz (con clientes y equipos internos) para generar confianza y alineación.
Visión colaborativa para trabajar de forma integrada con perfiles multidisciplinares.
Capacidad de adaptación y aprendizaje continuo, especialmente ante la evolución de la IA generativa y nuevos formatos de búsqueda.
Proactividad, responsabilidad y mentalidad de ownership (adueñarte del proyecto).

Conocimientos y experiencia

Mínimo 2-3 años de experiencia demostrable en proyectos SEO (al menos 1 año en agencia).
Trabajo demostrable en GEO durante los dos últimos años o desde la irrupción de la IA en motores de búsqueda.
Experiencia en la definición y ejecución de estrategias SEO enfocadas a resultados comerciales.
Dominio de herramientas clave del sector: Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Sistrix, Ahrefs, etc.
Analítica SEO y GEO avanzada y capacidad para extraer insights (dashboarding, reporting, data storytelling).
Se valora positivamente: Conocimientos básicos en APIs, SQL, Python y experiencia en entornos de automatización SEO.

Formación

Grado, Máster o FP relacionados con Marketing, Marketing Digital, Comunicación o titulaciones similares.
Formaciones complementarias y certificaciones específicas del ámbito SEO.
Se valora positivamente: Nivel de inglés conversacional.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

¡Un comienzo a lo grande!

Programa de onboarding diseñado para que te integres rápidamente en la compañía y te sientas parte del equipo desde el primer día, facilitandote las herramientas necesarias para tu adaptación a tu rol y a la cultura de SIDN.

Flexibilidad y equilibrio:

Modelo híbrido: Combina lo mejor de ambos mundos trabajando 3 días a la semana en nuestras espectaculares oficinas en pleno corazón de la Gran Vía de Granada y 2 días desde casa.
Teletrabajo 100%: Durante los periodos de Navidad, Semana Santa y verano para que disfrutes de una mayor comodidad y flexibilidad.

Vacaciones y más descanso:

25 días de vacaciones por convenio.
Tu cumpleaños libre para celebrarlo como prefieras. 🎉
Long Weekends: ¡12 viernes al año libres!
Mes adicional por baja de maternidad o paternidad.

Desarrollo profesional continuo:

Programas de formación interna y externa adaptados a tus necesidades.
Idiomas, liderazgo y especialización avanzada en áreas clave del marketing digital, social media, analítica de datos, herramientas de reporting e Inteligencia Artificial.
Acceso ilimitado a libros y recursos de aprendizaje para potenciar tus habilidades técnicas y consultivas.

Todo lo que necesitas para trabajar al máximo nivel:

Equipamiento de oficina premium y herramientas de monitorización avanzadas idóneas para que gestiones y analices las comunidades de la forma más cómoda y eficiente.

Beneficios exclusivos para empleados :

Descuentos en marcas líderes del mercado.

Compromiso con el impacto social:

Planes de voluntariado: participa en proyectos solidarios del entorno.
Planes de inclusión: apoyamos proyectos para la integración de colectivos vulnerables y prioritarios, promoviendo de forma activa un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y cohesionado.

Un entorno dinámico y colaborativo:

Un equipo apasionado donde crecer, con planes de carrera estructurados y un ambiente de constante aprendizaje y excelencia.

Sobre SIDN

SIDN es una compañía especializada en marketing digital, tecnología e innovación, comprometida con ofrecer un servicio de consultoría digital y estratégico de la máxima calidad. Llevamos más de 24 años transformando e impulsando negocios e instituciones en el canal digital, trabajando de la mano de grandes marcas, corporaciones líderes y ambiciosos proyectos internacionales, generando soluciones innovadoras con impacto real y medible.

¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

Presencia global: Oficinas consolidadas en Granada, Madrid, Barcelona, Colonia, Miami y Santiago de Chile, ofreciendo una infraestructura sólida de soporte para todos nuestros equipos e implants.
Proyectos de envergadura: Colaboramos con clientes internacionales en proyectos que abarcan más de 60 países y se gestionan en más de 10 idiomas.
Cultura basada en el talento: Formada por un equipo humano de más de 200 profesionales apasionados, en constante crecimiento continuo y orientados firmemente hacia el aprendizaje continuo, la excelencia y la colaboración.
Crecimiento continuo: Nuestro éxito no solo se mide en resultados para nuestros clientes, sino también en nuestro propio crecimiento: más del 50% anual en los últimos 5 años y un impresionante 70% en los últimos 12 meses.
Entre las 500 primeras Pymes de España en crecimiento 2025.

Cultura que inspira

Creemos en construir un entorno donde puedas desarrollarte profesionalmente con el soporte de una metodología sólida de agencia. Fomentamos la flexibilidad adaptada a cada tipo de proyecto y contamos con reconocimientos externos que avalan nuestro foco en el bienestar del equipo y el crecimiento ordenado del talento digital.

¿Cómo es el proceso de selección en SIDN?

En SIDN buscamos personas con talento y ganas de marcar la diferencia. Nuestro proceso está diseñado de forma personalizada para que nos conozcamos a fondo y confirmemos la idoneidad con el proyecto:

Revisión de candidaturas: Analizamos detenidamente tu trayectoria profesional, así como los requerimientos y el portfolio aportados.
Entrevistas personalizadas: Realizamos hasta 3 entrevistas enfocadas en conocer tus conocimientos técnicos, habilidades, competencias y aptitudes para el entorno presencial en cliente y encaje con nuestra filosofía y cultura corporativa.
Propuesta final: Si eres la persona seleccionada, te presentaremos la oferta formal con las condiciones y detalles operativos de tu incorporacion, el equipo de soporte de SIDN y las condiciones específicas.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Digital Marketing Executive – SEO Specialization
Company: Movate
Role: Digital Marketing Executive – SEO
Experience: 1–4 Years
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Movate
About the Company Movate, formerly called CSS CORP, is a new age services company that harnesses the power of
digital technologies to reimagine customer engagements. We enable businesses to anticipate and face disruptions
effectively through our digital, technology and support services. We are a global customer experience and
technology consulting services provider and a digital transformation partner of choice for its clients, which includes
the world’s top innovators across industries, from mid-market players to large enterprises. We have a diverse team
of over 11,500 customer-centric thinkers, collaborators, and co creators across 20 global locations.

Role Summary
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive with strong core SEO skills to grow organic visibility, traffic and
qualified leads. While SEO will be the primary focus, the role also contributes across the wider digital marketing
mix, including content, social media, paid campaigns, email marketing and analytics.
Key Responsibilities
Search Engine Optimization (Primary – approx. 70%)
• Keyword & competitor research: Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search-intent
mapping to build and maintain the SEO roadmap.
• On-page SEO: Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, images and schema
markup.
• Technical SEO: Run regular site audits and resolve issues relating to crawlability, indexation, site speed,
Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps and robots.txt.
• Off-page SEO: Plan and execute ethical link-building through guest posts, digital PR, outreach and
partnerships; monitor and manage the backlink profile.
• SEO content: Brief writers, optimize blogs and landing pages, and refresh existing content to improve
rankings.
• Local SEO: Manage Google Business Profile and local citations where relevant.
• Emerging search: Optimize content for featured snippets and AI-driven search experiences (AI Overviews,
answer engines).
• Reporting: Track rankings, organic traffic, conversions and visibility; prepare weekly and monthly
performance reports with insights and recommendations.
Other Digital Marketing (Supporting – approx. 30%)
• Support Google Ads and paid social (LinkedIn, Meta) campaigns, including setup, keyword/audience
selection and performance monitoring.
• Plan and schedule social media content and track engagement.
• Assist with email marketing campaigns, newsletters and basic marketing automation.
• Coordinate website updates and landing pages in the CMS (e.g. WordPress) and recommend CRO
improvements.
• Set up and maintain tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager; build dashboards in Looker Studio.
• Work with design, content, sales and web teams to align campaigns with business goals.
Quality & Documentation
• Follow search engine guidelines and use only ethical, white-hat SEO practices; avoid spammy or
manipulative tactics.
• Maintain keyword trackers, audit checklists, content calendars and SEO documentation.
• Stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, and adapt strategy accordingly.
• Communicate priorities clearly, meet deadlines and proactively flag risks or opportunities.
Required Skills & Qualifications
• 1–3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in a B2B, IT services or agency environment.
• Strong command of on-page, off-page and technical SEO fundamentals and current search engine
guidelines.
• Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush/Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Moz.
• Working knowledge of at least two additional digital marketing areas, such as paid media (Google Ads/paid
social), social media, content marketing, email marketing or CRO.
• Familiarity with WordPress or similar CMS; basic understanding of HTML/CSS.
• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.
• Ability to analyze data, interpret trends and translate them into clear actions.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Preferred / Good to Have
• Google Analytics, Google Ads or HubSpot certifications.
• Experience with international or multi-location SEO.
• Exposure to AI tools for content, research and SEO workflows.
• Basic graphic/content tools knowledge (e.g. Canva).
Key Performance Indicators
• Growth in organic traffic, keyword rankings and organic leads/conversions.
• Improvement in technical site health and Core Web Vitals scores.
• Quality and quantity of backlinks acquired.
• Timely, accurate reporting and campaign execution.
Personal Attributes
• Analytical, detail-oriented and results-driven.
• Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Collaborative team player.
Application Requirements
Candidates should share an updated CV and, where possible, a brief example of an SEO project describing the
challenge, actions taken, tools used and results achieved. Please do not include confidential client or employer
information.

Who We Are

At Fonroche Lighting America, we are transforming the way outdoor spaces are illuminated with off-grid, solar-powered street lighting. As the industry leader in autonomous solar lighting, we provide municipalities, developers, and commercial facilities with a cost-effective, reliable, and sustainable alternative to traditional grid-connected lighting.

With our U.S. headquarters in Fort Worth, TX, and regional offices nationwide, we are rapidly expanding—offering a dynamic work environment where innovation meets impact.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SEO Specialist to join our Marketing Team and lead the continued growth of our organic search presence. This role will focus on technical SEO, keyword strategy, content optimization, search intent, analytics, and organic performance.

Working alongside the Marketing Team, you will develop and execute SEO strategies that increase our visibility across traditional search engines while ensuring our website provides valuable, authoritative information to prospective customers. You will work across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, competitor research, and performance analytics to improve rankings, qualified organic traffic, and conversions.

As search continues to evolve, you will also stay informed on emerging AI-powered search experiences and incorporate relevant best practices into our broader organic search strategy.

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Organic Growth

Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with company marketing and business goals.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent analysis, SERP analysis, and content-gap research.
Identify opportunities to increase organic visibility for high-value commercial, municipal, industry, and product-related searches.
Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and overall search performance.
Develop strategies to improve rankings, qualified traffic, engagement, and lead generation.
Research emerging search trends and adjust SEO strategies accordingly.

Technical SEO

Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.
Monitor and improve site architecture, crawlability, indexability, canonicalization, redirects, internal linking, and URL structure.
Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and overall website performance.
Identify and troubleshoot technical issues affecting organic visibility.
Implement and maintain structured data and Schema.org markup.
Work with development and website resources to prioritize and resolve technical SEO issues.
Support SEO requirements for website redesigns, migrations, new pages, and other website initiatives.

On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

Optimize existing website pages to improve rankings, relevance, and user experience.
Develop SEO recommendations for landing pages, product pages, case studies, FAQs, blog articles, project pages, and educational resources.
Create SEO-focused content briefs based on keyword research, customer questions, search intent, and competitive analysis.
Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal links, image attributes, URLs, and on-page content.
Develop and maintain topic clusters to strengthen topical authority.
Identify opportunities to improve existing content based on search performance and changing search intent.
Ensure content is optimized for both search engines and human readers.

Link Building & Authority

Identify opportunities to strengthen website authority through high-quality backlinks, industry mentions, partnerships, and digital PR.
Monitor backlink profiles and identify potentially harmful or low-quality links.
Research competitor backlink strategies and identify relevant opportunities.
Support strategies that increase the company's authority and visibility within relevant industries.

Analytics & Reporting

Establish and monitor SEO KPIs and performance benchmarks.
Track organic rankings, traffic, conversions, engagement, backlinks, and technical SEO health.
Use Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other SEO tools to analyze performance.
Identify trends and opportunities within organic search data.
Prepare regular SEO performance reports and communicate actionable insights to the Marketing Director and other stakeholders.
Connect organic search performance to qualified leads and broader marketing objectives.

AI & Emerging Search

Stay current with developments in AI-powered search and evolving search engine features.
Monitor how AI-generated search experiences may affect organic search behavior and website visibility.
Identify opportunities to structure and optimize content so it can be effectively understood and surfaced by emerging search technologies.
Incorporate relevant AI search, semantic search, and entity optimization practices into the overall SEO strategy as the industry evolves.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in B2B, technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, construction, SaaS, or other complex sales environments.
Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, search intent, and content optimization.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing SEO strategies.
Experience conducting technical SEO audits and identifying website optimization opportunities.
Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
Working knowledge of structured data and Schema.org.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple SEO initiatives and prioritize opportunities based on business impact.
Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and adapt as search engines and SEO best practices evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

WordPress experience; Avada experience is a plus.
Experience with enterprise or B2B SEO.
Experience with local and geographic SEO.
Experience with technical SEO for large or complex websites.
Experience with content strategy and topic-cluster development.
Experience with link-building, digital PR, and authority-building strategies.
Knowledge of entity SEO and semantic search.
Familiarity with AI-powered search platforms and emerging search technologies.
Experience in municipal, government, infrastructure, engineering, construction, energy, sustainability, or architectural markets is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the successful candidate will help our company:

Increase qualified organic visibility and rankings for high-value commercial and municipal searches.
Increase qualified organic traffic and conversions.
Improve the technical health, crawlability, and overall SEO performance of the website.
Build stronger topical authority around customer needs, applications, technologies, products, and markets.
Identify and capitalize on new keyword and content opportunities.
Develop a consistent, data-driven SEO reporting and optimization process.
Improve the company's authority and visibility within relevant search results.
Establish a scalable SEO strategy that supports continued organic growth.

The Candidate We’re Looking For

We're looking for an SEO professional who is equally comfortable digging into technical website issues, analyzing search data, researching competitors, and identifying content opportunities.

You should be able to look at a website and determine not only what is preventing it from ranking, but also what opportunities exist to improve its visibility and attract the right customers. We're looking for someone who is analytical, curious, proactive, and excited about building a strong organic search presence for a growing company.

About the Role
We’re looking for a sharp SEO specialist who learns fast, works smart with AI, and takes ownership of results.
We care more about how quickly you pick things up than how long you’ve been doing this. If you’ve spent a year in SEO and already work faster and better than people with three, we want to hear from you.
At Digiholic, SEO covers the full picture of search: Google rankings, AI Overviews, and how brands show up in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. You’ll work across B2B and B2C clients in India, the US and other markets, with direct mentoring from founders who have built SEO results for over two decades.

What You’ll Own
SEO performance for your client accounts: rankings, traffic, AI visibility and leads, with KPIs that are yours to hit
Keyword and intent research that focuses on what drives business, not just volume
On-page and technical SEO: audits, fixes, schema, internal linking, and working with our developer on anything beyond your reach
Content direction with the writing team: briefs, topic clusters and refresh plans
Monthly reports that explain what moved, why, and what you’re doing next
Using AI tools to work faster, and checking their output so speed never costs accuracy
Blog uploads and basic website upkeep

What We’re Looking For
1 to 3 years in SEO, or less if your work speaks for itself
Results you can point to, with a clear account of what you personally did
Comfort with GSC, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and a crawler like Screaming Frog
Real, daily use of AI tools in your SEO workflow, not just for writing
Clear communication: you speak up, ask questions, and flag problems early
The confidence to own a number and explain it when it goes up or down

Bonus Points If You
Have built your own prompts, workflows or automations for SEO tasks
Have tested ways to get a brand cited in AI search results

Who This Role Isn’t For
If you prefer waiting for instructions, this won’t be the right fit. We’re looking for someone who comes to us with what they found, what they think, and what they’ve already tried.

Why Join Digiholic?
You’ll own real accounts across industries and countries, learn directly from founders, and grow as fast as your results allow.

Send your resume to andrew@digiholic.in. Start your subject line with DIG-SEO-2026 .
In the body of the email (not as an attachment), answer both in under 150 words total:
Describe one SEO task you’ve made significantly faster using AI. Which tools did you use, and how did you check the output was correct?
Share one result you owned, with numbers.

Estamos creciendo y queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo en Zaragoza a una persona con talento para transformar los datos en crecimiento. Buscamos un especialista en SEO & GEO (Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization) con pasión por proyectos de ecommerce y con experiencia en estrategias de crecimiento para unirse a nuestro equipo en Zaragoza.

Formarás parte de un equipo joven, con capacidad para hacer grandes proyectos, que cuidan tanto la parte visual como la tecnológica. Trabajarás junto a los equipos para entender sus retos y darles respuesta mediante dashboards y soluciones visuales que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Profundizarás en los datos para encontrar áreas de mejora operativa y nuevas vías para potenciar el crecimiento de los proyectos. Conocerás nuestras herramientas y flujos de trabajo y trabajarás en equipo con todas las áreas de la empresa.

Participarás compartiendo tu experiencia junto con los equipos de todas las áreas en un ambiente en el que predomina el compañerismo, la pasión y el cuidado por el trabajo bien hecho y la autoexigencia para aportar las mejores soluciones a cada proyecto.

Más de 4-5 años de experiencia profesional en SEO, idealmente en entorno agencia y gestionando proyectos eCommerce o internacionales de cierto volumen.
Pasión y experimentación demostrable con herramientas de IA generativa y una comprensión clara de cómo está evolucionando el comportamiento del usuario hacia las búsquedas conversacionales y de long-tail.

Base sólida en SEO Técnico y de contenidos, con capacidad para entender arquitecturas complejas, indexación selectiva y optimización del crawl budget.

Dominio absoluto de la arquitectura web, gestión del crawl budget, indexación selectiva, códigos de estado HTTP y datos estructurados avanzados (Schema.org en JSON-LD).

Capacidad de análisis cualitativo y cuantitativo para justificar el ROI del canal orgánico en los proyectos.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo, proactividad y orientación a resultados.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal con clientes.
Organización, responsabilidad y cuidado por los detalles.

Conocimientos en automatización de tareas y Programmatic SEO(uso de Python, R o scripts para procesamiento de datos masivos o conexión con APIs).
Experiencia identificando y solventando problemas de indexación y renderizado en webs desarrolladas con frameworks de JavaScript(React, Next.js, Angular, etc.).

items.description:
Reelotek is a dynamic and fast-growing non-ferrous metals trading company with operations in Delhi NCR and Haryana. We specialize in trading high-quality zinc ingots, aluminum ingots, and aluminum wirerods, catering to diverse industries. With a commitment to reliable supply solutions and competitive pricing, we pride ourselves on building long-term relationships with our clients.

Vacancy: SEO Executive
Location: Delhi NCR
Experience: 1.5–3 years of hands-on SEO experience; proven ability to independently manage a website’s SEO
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, IT or a related field; relevant practical experience is essential. Certifications in SEO, Google Analytics (GA4) or Google Search Console are an advantage.

Job Summary
Reelotek is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented SEO Executive to independently own and execute the company’s complete organic search strategy. The candidate must be hands-on across on-page, off-page and technical SEO, with working knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). This role includes keyword research, blog research and writing, quality backlink building, website audits, analytics, implementation and regular performance reporting.

Key Responsibilities

On-Page SEO, Keyword Research & Content:
• Own end-to-end SEO planning and execution for the Reelotek Metals website.
• Conduct industry, competitor and search-intent research; build keyword maps for product, category and blog pages.
• Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, images, schema markup and landing-page content.
• Implement on-page SEO directly on WordPress websites, including page titles, meta descriptions, H1–H6 headings, URL slugs, image alt text, internal linking, content updates and SEO plugin settings (e.g., Yoast SEO or Rank Math).
• Research topics, create a blog calendar, and independently write, edit, publish or coordinate SEO-focused website blogs and articles.

Off-Page SEO & Backlink Building:
• Plan and execute ethical, relevant backlink outreach, guest posting, business listings and industry-specific link acquisition.
• Audit backlink quality, monitor referring domains and identify potentially harmful links; prioritize quality over volume.

Technical SEO:
• Run regular crawls and audits using Screaming Frog and other SEO tools; resolve indexing, crawlability, redirects, canonicals, duplicate content, broken links and XML sitemap issues.
• Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, robots.txt, structured data and website architecture; implement fixes independently where access and skills permit.
• Use Google Search Console to identify and troubleshoot search-performance and indexing problems.

AEO, GEO & Search Updates:
• Optimize content for featured snippets, People Also Ask, conversational queries and answer-first search experiences.
• Apply GEO best practices to improve content clarity, authority, entity relevance and eligibility for AI-powered search discovery, without promising placement.
• Stay current with Google Search updates, algorithm changes and evolving AI search practices; adapt strategies proactively.

SEO Tools, Tracking & Reporting:
• Work confidently with SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Ubersuggest, Google Search Console and keyword / competitor research tools.
• Set up, use and troubleshoot GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM), including relevant events, conversions and tracking checks.
• Track organic traffic, keyword visibility, rankings, qualified enquiries, conversions, backlinks and technical health; provide monthly reports and action plans.

Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong working knowledge of on-page, off-page and technical SEO, AEO and GEO.
• Practical ability to research and write clear, original, search-optimized B2B / industrial website content.
• Hands-on expertise in SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Ubersuggest, Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
• Understanding of HTML, basic CSS, CMS publishing (e.g., WordPress), schema markup and technical troubleshooting.
• Self-driven execution, high attention to detail, ownership and awareness of Google search updates.

What We Offer
• Opportunity to independently own the organic growth of a growing industrial business.
• Professional, collaborative work environment with direct impact on digital visibility and inbound enquiries.

جزئیات و انتظارات دقیق پروژه:
۱. ساختار و چیدمان صفحه اصلی:
نمایش محصولات و کنسول‌ها در صفحه اصلی به گونه‌ای باشد که هرچقدر فضا صفحه اجازه می‌دهد و استاندارد است، کنسول‌ها و محصولات در دید کاربر قرار گیرند (بدون شلوغی بیش از حد، اما پربار و جذاب).
حذف موارد اضافی و نامرتبطِ باقی‌مانده از قالب دمو.
۲. جداسازی صفحات محصولات:
PS4 سرعت و عملکرد:
بهینه‌سازی سرعت بارگذاری سایت (در دسکتاپ و موبایل)
فعال‌سازی سیستم کش، فشرده‌سازی و اقدامات لازم برای لود آنی
۴. امنیت سایت:
نصب و تنظیم افزونه امنیتی، فایروال و محافظت از پنل ادمین
تهیه بکاپ کامل قبل از شروع کار
۵. سئو (SEO):
نصب و تنظیمات پایه افزونه سئو، بهینه‌سازی ساختار لینک‌ها و تصاویر
ثبت نقشه سایت (Sitemap) و آماده‌سازی برای ایندکس گوگل
۶. نمایش در موبایل (ریسپانسیو):
بررسی کامل و رفع هرگونه به‌هم‌ریختگی در نسخه موبایل.
شرایط و خروجی مورد انتظار:
پروژه از صفر نیست (قالب نصب شده) و هدف، بهینه‌سازی کامل، مرتب‌سازی، سئو، سرعت، امنیت و تفکیک صفحات است.
ارائه گزارش کوتاه از کارهای انجام‌شده در پایان کار.

items.title: Specialista SEO e GEO
items.description:
NUR cerca un/una SEO & GEO Specialist. Il primo progetto? Automatizzare la reportistica con gli agenti AI. Non cerco necessariamente dieci anni di esperienza. Cerco competenza, curiosità e la volontà concreta di assumersi la responsabilità di un progetto nuovo.
In NUR abbiamo introdotto gli agenti AI per svolgere attività specifiche e ripensare i nostri processi. Ora cerchiamo una persona che contribuisca a questa trasformazione nel mondo SEO e GEO.
Pensiamo a un profilo con circa 3–5 anni di esperienza nella SEO, una conoscenza concreta della GEO e un forte interesse per il mondo degli agenti AI. Tre anni ben spesi possono essere sufficienti: conta ciò che sai fare e quello che sei disposto a imparare.
Da dove partiremo Il primo obiettivo è preciso: portare la reportistica SEO e GEO verso un processo automatizzato, dalla raccolta dei dati alla preparazione e all’invio dei report.
Non vogliamo semplicemente far scrivere a un’AI il commento a un grafico. Vogliamo costruire un processo affidabile, con controlli sulla qualità dei dati e degli output, che riduca il lavoro ripetitivo e lasci più spazio all’analisi e alle decisioni.
La persona che cerchiamo dovrà contribuire a definire questo processo, sperimentarlo, verificarne i risultati e migliorarlo. L’automazione deve togliere lavoro ripetitivo, non attenzione e responsabilità.
Chi vorrei incontrare Una persona con basi SEO solide, abituata a leggere i dati e trasformarli in interventi concreti. Che stia già approfondendo la GEO e abbia voglia di capire come integrare gli agenti AI nel proprio lavoro.
Non serve conoscere già tutto del mondo agentico. Serve volerci entrare davvero: studiare, provare, fare domande, riconoscere gli errori e correggerli.
Cerchiamo autonomia e spirito d’iniziativa, non la pretesa di avere sempre la risposta pronta. Essere responsabili, per noi, significa anche segnalare un problema in tempo, chiedere un confronto e proporre una soluzione.
Che opportunità troverai Non soltanto la gestione di attività SEO già definite, ma la possibilità di costruire nuovi metodi di lavoro e sviluppare competenze nella GEO, nell’automazione e nell’utilizzo degli agenti AI.
È un ruolo per chi vuole continuare a crescere anche quando questo significa mettere in discussione il modo in cui ha lavorato fino a ieri.
Per candidarti, andiamo sul concreto Scrivimi qui su LinkedIn con il tuo CV o profilo e tre brevi risposte:
Un progetto SEO che hai seguito: il tuo contributo e un risultato misurabile, anche presentato in forma anonima.
Che cosa hai studiato o sperimentato nella GEO e con l’AI: vanno bene anche esperimenti personali, purché concreti.
Quale attività della reportistica automatizzeresti per prima e perché: bastano poche righe, non una proposta progettuale.
Non serve una lunga lettera di presentazione. Ci interessa capire come lavori, come ragioni e perché vuoi affrontare questa sfida.

🔴 بررسی و بهبود سئو و بازاریابی دیجیتال دو وب‌سایت

🔹 برای بررسی و بهبود سئو و بازاریابی دیجیتال دو وب‌سایت فعال، به فریلنسر متخصص و باتجربه نیاز داریم. هدف، شناسایی مشکلات و فرصت‌ها و ارائه برنامه‌ای عملی برای بهبود سئو، جذب ورودی هدفمند و عملکرد سایت‌هاست.
در بررسی اولیه، هر دو سایت از نظر سئوی تکنیکال و داخلی، ساختار صفحات و لینک‌سازی داخلی، ایندکس و مشکلات احتمالی Google Search Console، سرعت و Core Web Vitals، کلمات کلیدی و رتبه‌های فعلی، محتوا و شکاف‌های محتوایی، بک‌لینک و سئوی خارجی، رقبا، نرخ تبدیل و مسیر ورود کاربران ارزیابی شوند. همچنین وضعیت کلی بازاریابی دیجیتال و فرصت‌های جذب ترافیک و مشتری بررسی شود.
پیشنهاد اولیه باید مهم‌ترین مشکلات مشاهده‌شده، اقدامات پیشنهادی برای رفع آن‌ها، اولویت‌بندی، زمان تقریبی اجرا، برنامه اقدامات ۳۰، ۶۰ و ۹۰ روز اول و هزینه پیشنهادی را مشخص کند. در صورت امکان، نمونه پروژه‌های مشابه و نتایج پیشین نیز ارائه شود. برای اقدامات پیشنهادی، زمان‌بندی و KPI قابل اندازه‌گیری اعلام شود.
هدف صرفاً دریافت گزارش نیست؛ در صورت توافق، انتظار می‌رود فریلنسر اجرای اقدامات لازم برای بهبود هر دو سایت را نیز بر عهده بگیرد. در پیشنهاد مشخص شود کدام بخش‌ها را شخصاً انجام می‌دهد و برای کدام بخش‌ها، در صورت نیاز، به برنامه‌نویس، تولیدکننده محتوا یا تخصص‌های دیگر نیاز خواهد بود. دامنه دقیق اجرا پس از بررسی اولیه و توافق مشخص می‌شود.

items.description:
Description

SEO specialist will identify strategies, techniques and tactics to increase the number of visitors to a website b2b Kantorku.id and obtain a high-ranking placement in the results page of search engines. By generating more leads for the business they should open up new opportunities for driving growth and profit.

Responsibilities

About the Role

You'll be part of Dealls’ SEO team, driving organic traffic and user acquisition across our entire ecosystem including job portal pages, category pages, blog, and experimental growth pages. Your work will directly impact how millions of Indonesians discover job opportunities through Dealls.

SEO Strategy & Execution

Develop and execute SEO strategies aligned with Dealls’ business goals.
Identify growth opportunities across site structure, content, and search trends.
Stay ahead of algorithm changes and industry best practices.
Analyze competitor strategies (SEO + GEO) and identify content gaps or opportunities.

Keyword Research & Content Optimization

Conduct keyword research to uncover high-value opportunities for job portal and blog content.
Collaborate with SEO Writers & Editors to create high-quality, relevant, and SEO-driven content.
Provide structured keyword briefs and content recommendations.

Technical SEO

Perform regular technical audits (crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, etc.).
Work closely with the Engineering team to implement fixes and technical improvements.
Ensure job detail pages, job categories, company pages, and blog articles meet SEO standards.

On-Page & Off-Page Optimization

Optimize meta tags, URL structures, internal linking, and overall UX to boost ranking performance.
Execute link-building initiatives to strengthen domain authority and organic reach.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Track traffic, rankings, CTR, and overall site health using GA4, GSC, Ahrefs/Semrush.
Prepare regular reports with actionable insights for stakeholders.
Monitor traffic, rankings, CTR, AI-search impressions, and overall site performance using GA4, GSC, Ahrefs/Semrush + AI visibility trackers.

Competitor & Market Analysis

Analyze job portal competitors and market trends.
Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities to improve search performance.

Requirements

1+ year of experience as an SEO Specialist or similar role (preferably for large-scale or high-traffic websites).
Proficient with SEO tools: GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, Screaming Frog, etc.
Familiar with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CMS platforms like WordPress or headless CMS.
Strong data analysis skills with the ability to convert insights into action.
Excellent communication skills, comfortable working with Engineering, Product, and Content teams.
Updated with the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and best practices.

items.title: SEO & AI Search Specialist - London
items.description:
Organisational Context
Founded by Harry Sanders in 2015, StudioHawk is a specialised agency dedicated to search engine optimisation. Our SEO services are responsive, ethical, authentic and delivered by a genuinely passionate and diverse team of SEO specialists in London, Melbourne, Sydney and Atlanta.

The UK office was founded by Anthony Barone, based in Shoreditch, London. We have over 65 clients in multiple industries and multiple platforms, based in the UK, EU, and USA.

There's a reason why we have scooped awards at the UK Search Awards and Global Search Awards since opening up shop here in the UK - It's in our proven track record.

StudioHawk clients reach their SEO goals. We use white-hat SEO techniques to make sure sites succeed and aren't at risk from Google penalties. Over 400 campaigns and never a single penalisation or manual action due to our work.

There are no generalists here; we are just a damn good SEO & AI Search agency.

Mission
We lead our industry by striving to be the difference by educating, building and evolving passionate people.
We want StudioHawk's basics to be someone else's great.
We aim to deliver the best SEO, simply.

Our Values
Create WOW: We are passionate about SEO. Creating WOW in our SEO campaigns is what makes us exceptional.
We've Got Each Other's Backs: A strong culture of collaboration is crucial to our success.
Confident Yet Humble: We know our actions speak louder than words. Ego is the enemy.
Continuous Growth & Learning: We want StudioHawk's basics to be another agency's great.

Primary Purpose of the Position
The SEO & AI Search Specialist is primarily responsible for managing a portfolio of client SEO campaigns, delivering strong technical, on-page, and content work, and contributing fresh thinking that helps our clients grow their organic visibility. You'll work closely with the SEO Team Leader and senior team members, with a clear path to progression as you develop your expertise.

You've got a minimum of three years delivering SEO inside a fast-moving environment and can walk into a client account with zero hand-holding. You follow industry developments in your own time. You use AI tools to do better work, not just faster work. You're not here to coast; you're here to grow and better yourself.

Manage and optimise SEO campaigns and sprints across a diverse client portfolio
Identify opportunities and develop strategic, data-backed recommendations
Monitor campaign performance and make proactive optimisation decisions
Prepare performance reports with clear analysis and next steps
Support the SEO Team Leader with ad hoc campaign requirements
Contribute directly to live client campaigns from week one, executing technical, on-page, and content work under the SEO Team Leader's direction.

Implement strong on-page optimisation strategies across client sites
Execute off-site strategies and conduct link profile analysis
Keep up to date with algorithm changes and search engine developments
Leverage AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your analysis and execution of SEO tasks

Content & Strategy

Conduct content audits and provide content ideation and brief support
Contribute fresh perspectives on how clients can differentiate in search

Trial and test new SEO-related opportunities and share learnings with the team

Client & Team Support

Commitment to StudioHawk Culture

Professional development

Attend in-house training, external webinars, and courses where available

Performance Measurements
An annual work plan will be developed in line with the Position Description and StudioHawk's Annual Business Plan to measure performance.

items.description:
We Are Primal

Primal is the marketing partner designed to meet the needs of brands today. Our different approach of globally-minded yet locally-tuned people sets us apart. With a digital-first approach, our core pillars incorporate: Strategy, Search, Performance, Creative, Social, and Data.

Underpinned by integrated teams that ensure consistency and accelerated results, we're committed to creating impact and deep relationships.

Partnering with Primal means opting for a path less traveled. A commitment to not just progress but to think differently. With us, you’re making a statement about your vision for the future. At Primal, we're not just an agency; we deliver outcomes.

Since launching in 2015, we’ve helped over 300 high-performing brands through our strategic and data-driven marketing approach. We transform the clients we work with. We have a 96% client satisfaction rate, with over 95% of brands choosing to continue working with us on a recurring basis.

Our integrated approach represents our flagship offering to clients, where we apply our proprietary strategic planning process, INSTINCT®, designed to close the gap between our clients, their competition, and their customers. This is where everything starts at Primal. It's the essential catalyst for helping transform our brand partners into the successful titans of industry. We specifically blend marketing with a consulting service model that enables clients to identify and overcome the biggest growth challenges.

Role:

The Senior SEO Specialist is a crucial role within our Technical Department, enabling us to improve website visibility for clients across diverse brands and industries. Specifically, this entails:

Analyzing, reviewing, and making recommendations for websites to increase visibility.
Conducting keyword research to drive qualified traffic.
Developing and executing link-building strategies.
Creating detailed SEO strategy reports.
Serving as the lead point of contact for all matters related to your accounts.

This role demands a mastery level of SEO analysis, strategic thinking, technical expertise, communication, adaptability, and collaboration. To be successful, you must have:
Proven experience in SEO strategies and best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Exceptional organizational and communication abilities.

Why this is important for you:

You will have a unique opportunity for growth.
First, you’ll interact with high-performing brands, which will ‘level up’ your knowledge and network. You'll also work in a fast-paced environment with amazing people, where you’ll have the opportunity to make an immense impact.

Responsibilities:

External:
Perform keyword discovery, optimization, and technical website reviews to increase visibility.
Develop link-building strategies to drive domain authority and traffic.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, managing account performance and meeting objectives.

Internal:
Analyze data and results to identify trends and ensure maximum ROI on paid search campaigns.
Create detailed strategy reports and present them to the team.
Prepare performance analysis reports and recommend corrective actions for ongoing optimization.
Support team members by sharing knowledge, conducting training, and developing materials to address skill gaps.
Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of team efficiency and productivity.

Results:
Drive organic traffic growth, keyword ranking improvements, and higher conversion rates.
Maintain a portfolio with a high client retention rate by effectively managing accounts and meeting SEO objectives.
Consistently deliver tasks on time, adhering to established processes and documentation standards.

Requirements:
Proven experience as an SEO Specialist or similar role.
Expertise in keyword research, technical SEO, and link-building strategies.
Strong proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms.
Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven mindset.
STRONG ENGLISH SKILL.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple projects.
A collaborative team player with a passion for learning and innovation.

Location:

Hybrid Bangkok, Thailand

Benefits:

Primal believes people are at the center of every success story. Our team has always claimed that the biggest benefit of being a part of our company is the opportunity to learn. Our fast-paced nature will serve as an accelerant to your professional growth and career.

Our central ethos involves hiring and developing hard-working, high-potential leaders. Success in this role WILL set you up for immense success (both within and outside the company).

In addition, Primal provides competitive compensation and benefits, including:
Fun and Young Environment
Company and Team Activities.
Health Insurance
Annual Company Retreat
Social Security
Annual and Birthday leave
Skill Development and Training

Primal Core Values:

Our values are the heart and soul of this high-growth company. The right person for this role also holds the same values, subscribes to them, and understands why each is critical to life and business.

Own It : Take absolute accountability for your actions.
Get It Done : Operate with urgency and purpose.
Hungry for Growth : Pursue progress with relentless curiosity and ambition.
One Tribe : Champion unity through empathy, respect, and trust.
Lead by Doing : Set the example for others to follow.

Candidates are subject to a test of their abilities.

items.title: SEO & Content Specialist
items.location: Center Sarajevo, Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bosnia and Herzegovina (Remote)
items.description:
FlyRank is an organic growth platform that helps brands get found on Google and inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini answers. We work with international clients, DTC brands and B2B SaaS companies.

We're opening several junior positions on our SEO and content team , and we don't need years of experience for any of them. We need go-getters: people who put in the work, learn fast, hustle, and want to help our leadership build the best autopilot for organic growth. This industry reinvents itself every few months. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't the role. If it sounds like the fun part, keep reading.

We also want people who are borderline obsessive about two things: clients being happy, and numbers going up. Not activity. Not deliverables shipped on time. Actual results, and a client who can see them. If you're the kind of person who checks a client's rankings before you check your own notifications, you'll fit here.

One thing to be clear about: we don't sit and write blog posts by hand. We build content. Our platform produces it at volume, and the job is to aim it well and hold the line on what comes out. Deciding what gets built, feeding the system the right inputs, and catching everything that isn't good enough to ship.

What you'll do
Keyword research, competitor analysis, and finding the topics worth building for
Turning that research into the briefs, prompts and inputs our platform runs on
Producing and publishing content through our internal platform
Reviewing what comes out: is it accurate, does it answer the query, does it sound like the client, would anyone actually read it
On-page optimization: titles, meta descriptions, internal linking, content structure
Tracking rankings, traffic, and content performance in Google Search Console and GA4
Basic technical checks: page speed, indexation, redirects, errors
Monitoring how client brands appear in AI-generated search results and reporting on it

What we're looking for
Obsession with client outcomes. You take it personally when a client isn't seeing results, and you don't wait to be asked before flagging it
Strong English, written and spoken. Most of our clients are in the US and EU, and you need to be able to judge whether content reads right for their audience
Judgment. You can tell the difference between content that is technically fine and content that is actually good, and you can say what needs to change
Curiosity, and the habit of digging into something yourself before asking
Care and accuracy when working with data and spreadsheets
Proficiency in using AI, and opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. We use it heavily, and the whole job is knowing what to do with what it gives you
Commitment to a long-term role, and availability to work from our Sarajevo office on hybrid days
Nice to have, not required: your own blog, newsletter or website, WordPress or Shopify experience, Excel skills, basic HTML

What we offer
Salary: above market for a junior role
Training from day one: learn directly from the team running projects for brands doing millions in revenue
Hybrid setup: split your week between the office and home, with the flexibility to arrange it around your work
Real ownership. We're small enough that what you build ships
Long-term employment and growth in your career

How to apply
Send your CV and a short note to careers@flyrank.com. In a few sentences, tell us about yourself and how you use AI.
That note is the first thing we'll judge you on, so treat it that way. We're not looking for a page-and-a-half cover letter. We're looking for someone who can say something real in a few clear sentences.

Want to stand out? Record a short video of yourself and send it over: why you want this opportunity, and what you bring. Optional, but it's the fastest way to get our attention.

items.title: SEO Specialist
items.description:
Job Description: SEO Specialist

Department: Marketing

Reporting to: Marketing Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview

Regent Group is seeking a highly skilled and hands-on SEO Specialist to manage

organic search performance across multiple Regent Group brands in Dubai and India.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the SEO Specialist will be responsible for

developing and executing SEO activity across technical SEO, on-page optimisation,

keyword research, content planning, link building and performance reporting.

This is a delivery-focused role. The successful candidate must be able to identify SEO

opportunities, implement improvements, work closely with the web developer and

content team, and take ownership of measurable organic growth. The individual must

be analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable managing several websites and priorities

simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy and Execution

Develop and implement SEO plans aligned with the objectives of each brands.
Conduct keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor analysis and

content-gap assessments.

Build keyword strategies for programmes, services, locations, campaigns and

priority audience segments.

Translate SEO recommendations into clear actions, deadlines and measurable

targets.

Manage SEO activity across multiple websites, brands and geographical

markets.

Stay informed about search-engine updates and adapt strategies accordingly.

Technical SEO

Conduct regular technical SEO audits using tools such as Semrush, Screaming

Frog, Google Search Console and PageSpeed Insights.

Identify and help resolve issues relating to crawling, indexing, redirects,

canonicals, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data and duplicate content.

Work closely with the web developer to implement technical recommendations.
Monitor website speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability and overall site

performance.

Review website migrations, redesigns and new-page launches to protect organic

visibility.

Test implemented changes and ensure technical issues are fully resolved.

On-Page SEO

Optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, image

attributes and on-page content.

Create detailed SEO briefs for new website pages, landing pages and blog

content.

Review existing content and identify opportunities to improve rankings,

engagement and conversions.

Ensure pages are optimised for relevant keywords without compromising

readability or brand quality.

Develop and maintain effective internal-linking structures across websites.
Support local and international SEO requirements where relevant.

Content and Collaboration

Work closely with the Marketing Manager to develop SEO-led content strategies.
Collaborate with content, social media, design and web development colleagues

to deliver SEO projects.

Identify content topics based on search demand, audience questions,

competitor performance and business priorities.

Review and optimise content before publication.
Ensure content is accurate, useful, original and aligned with the search intent of

the target audience.

Monitor content performance and recommend updates, consolidation or

removal where required.

Off-Page SEO and Authority Building

Identify relevant link-building, digital PR and partnership opportunities.
Monitor website authority and backlink profiles.
Identify and report potentially harmful or irrelevant backlinks.
Work with internal teams to develop authoritative and link-worthy content.
Track competitor backlink activity and identify realistic opportunities for Regent

Group brands.

Analytics and Reporting

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, impressions, clicks, engagement, conversions

and lead quality.

Use GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush and other tools to evaluate SEO

performance.

Produce regular reports for the Marketing Manager, clearly explaining results,

challenges and recommended actions.

Track SEO performance through to leads and conversions wherever possible.
Maintain accurate reporting dashboards for multiple brands and websites.
Use performance data to continuously improve SEO activity.

Required Experience And Skills

At least 2–4 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably across multiple

websites or brands.

Strong knowledge of technical, on-page, off-page and content SEO.
Proven experience improving organic visibility, traffic and conversions.
Proficiency in Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Screaming Frog and

keyword-research tools.

Good working knowledge of WordPress and website content-management

systems.

Understanding of HTML, CSS and website-development principles relevant to

SEO.

Experience working directly with web developers to resolve technical issues.
Strong keyword research, content briefing and competitor-analysis skills.
Understanding of international and local SEO would be advantageous.
Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Compliance Statement

Successful applicants will be required to complete pre-employment checks, including a criminal records check, two references, ID and Right to Work verification, and education confirmation. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion, selection for employment is based solely on an individual’s skills, qualifications, and experience relevant to the role.
